title: NASA Jupiter satellite sheet: Europa (II) mass 480.0×10^20 kg, radius 1560.8 km
summary: The Jupiter satellite fact sheet lists Europa (II) at mass 480.0 × 10^20 kg and radius 1560.8 km.
body: NASA's Jupiter satellite fact sheet lists Europa (II) with mass 480.0 × 10^20 kg, radius 1560.8 km, mean density 3010 kg/m^3, and visual geometric albedo 0.68. Orbital parameters on the same sheet: Semi-major axis (10 3 km) = 671.1; Semi-major axis (Jovian Radii) = 9.40; Orbital Period* (days) = 3.551181; Rotation Period (days) = S; Inclination (degrees) = 0.47; Eccentricity = 0.009. These are the cells printed on the sheet. The sheet does not say, on this row, which cells are a spacecraft measurement and which are an estimate. The sheet says R indicates retrograde motion, and S indicates synchronous rotation, the rotation period equal to the orbital period. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last Updated line: 6 December 2023.
